bullets.text: Commuters and residents in Thiruvallur demanded that the Chennai to Arakkonam suburban express train be operated with twelve coaches to ease travel.
The district team must monitor passenger response and coordinate with railway authorities regarding the demand to increase train coaches.
Bihar targeted artificial intelligence training for five lakh youth over five years under its proposed AI Policy 2026.
Experts highlighted the urgency in India for an armed AI defence force, independent system checks, and mandatory incident reporting.
Haf.vc invested three crore rupees in Hunar.AI for infrastructure, product development, sales, and market expansion.

takeaways: Residents demanded that Chennai-Arakkonam suburban express trains be operated with 12 coaches to ease crowding.
Railway authorities should evaluate passenger volume to decide on expanding train car capacities.

stories.title: Bihar AI Policy 2026 Targets Training for 5 Lakh Youth
takeaways: Bihar set a target to train five lakh young people in artificial intelligence over the next five years.
The initiative forms a core part of the upcoming Bihar Artificial Intelligence Policy 2026 implementation.

India needs a structured regulatory framework to secure critical digital networks against emerging threats.
